messages:
Javier (Sales): FYI handing Montara Health off to CS — signed last week, 6-month pilot, likely to scale if latency <200ms for 99th p95. They want SSO + VPC peering and run some PHI-adjacent evals.
Priya (CS): Thanks — taking ownership. Quick ask: do we have a target go-live date from Sales? any blocked items?
Javier (Sales): Customer aiming for pilot start by 2026-05-09. Blockers: SSO (Okta) mapping, VPC connectivity approval from their infra team, and a brief privacy questionnaire. Also flagged potential burst traffic during nightly batch scoring.
Marcus (Solutions Eng): Noted. For VPC peering we'll need the CIDR ranges and a contact on their infra side. On model side they want to run our rdx-13b-quant variant; we should validate tokenization + KV cache memory for long contexts (8k). I can own the perf test. Need GPU quota on Dedicated for pilot window.
Lena (Support): I'll set up an on-call rotation for the pilot. Any special logging / audit requirements? If they're PHI-adjacent, send me the exact fields so we can confirm redaction options.
Javier (Sales): Customer contact is Alice W. (Montara infra lead) — I'll intro in email after this thread. They requested: SSO SAML attributes (email, org_id, role), monthly billing, and a sandbox env isolated from prod.
Priya (CS): Plan proposal: 1) Intro email + Miro for rollout; 2) Kickoff meeting (Priya, Marcus, Lena, Alice) by 2026-04-22; 3) Access + SSO in staging by 2026-04-29; 4) Perf validation and DR runbook by 2026-05-06; 5) Pilot start 2026-05-09. Any objections?
Marcus (Solutions Eng): Timeline OK. Action: Marcus -> provision test harness and run baseline tokenization + throughput tests by 2026-04-28. I'll need the model weights variant and sample payloads.
Lena (Support): Action: Lena -> create a dedicated Slack channel and incident template for Montara, include escalation to Marcus + Priya. ETA 2026-04-25.
handoff-bot: checklist created: onboarding-intro, SSO-setup, VPC-peering, sandbox-provision, perf-tests, billing-plan, compliance-questions.
Priya (CS): Action owners summary:
- Javier (Sales): intro email to Alice + share infra contact (today)
- Priya (CS): run kickoff + enablement agenda (by 2026-04-20)
- Marcus (SE): perf harness + quota request (by 2026-04-28)
- Lena (Support): channel + incident template (by 2026-04-25)
- Security review: common checklist (Priya to coordinate with Security team)
Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept your action items.
Marcus (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: I'll add a short script that simulates their nightly batch pattern and share results in the channel.
Lena (Support): :thumbsup: adding PagerDuty policy and runbook stub.
Javier (Sales): Posting intro email draft here, will send after approvals: "Hey Alice — excited to kick off with Montara. Looping in Priya, Marcus, Lena from CS/SE/Support. Proposed kickoff 4/22. Attached: SSO attribute mapping and onboarding checklist." Any edits before I send?
Priya (CS): Looks good. Add a line about data residency and audit logs availability. Also ask for a single technical contact for VPC peering to avoid delays.
Javier (Sales): Done, sending now. I'll update thread with Alice's Slack handle once she confirms.
Priya (CS): Closing notes: renewal risk low for pilot, medium-long term depends on perf and cost per token; we'll capture feedback each week during pilot and include a small eval suite for quality regressions. If any blocker appears, tag @Marcus and @Lena immediately.
Marcus (Solutions Eng): A couple technical gotchas to watch: 1) long-context KV cache spikes memory, 2) quant variant sometimes causes subtle tokenization differences — include a small prompt set in perf tests.
Lena (Support): Will prepare the onboarding FAQ for the customer with SSO steps + troubleshooting steps for common connectivity errors.
Javier (Sales): Thanks team. Priya, if you want me to join kickoff to help with contract questions I can. Otherwise marking as handed off.
Priya (CS): Appreciate it — will keep you looped for any contract clarifications. Marking handoff complete pending kickoff.
